newsitem.title: USA: Group has Intermedia Communications stake.
newsitem.headline: Group has Intermedia Communications stake.

text.p: A group controlled by investment adviser and manager Lang Gerhard of Greenbrae, Calif., said Friday it had acquired 975,000 common shares of Intermedia Communications Inc, or 6.0 percent of the shares outstanding.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group, which includes investment adviser West Highland Capital Inc, said it had acquired the stake for $25.1 million, for investment purposes.
The group said it bought 175,000 of its shares between March 18 and 25 at prices ranging from $16.15 to $17.1875 a share.
